id: title:estefaniarabadan:give run finalization ownership one named home

review.posthog_relevance: Adds runtime ownership contract and status distinction for warehouse ingestion workflows, preventing status overwrites and premature lock release.
review.reason: Adds a helper variable and documentation to distinguish zero-batch runs from successful ones, establishing a runtime ownership contract for workflow terminal status and v3 sync lock release. This prevents the workflow from overwriting status or releasing the lock when the load consumer has already finalized the run, and ensures the workflow finalizes the run when no batches were.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the correctness of the workflow's dependency on the consumer's status, which is not independently verified in this chunk; the score assumes the implementation correctly handles the described edge cases.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed.

observations.behavior: Adds a new field `consumer_manages_job_status` and its documentation, and a helper variable `consumer_will_hear_about_this_run` to distinguish zero-batch runs from successful ones.
observations.posthog_connection: This change establishes a runtime ownership contract for the workflow's terminal status and v3 sync lock release. It prevents the workflow from overwriting status or releasing the lock when the load consumer has already finalized the run, and ensures the workflow finalizes the run when no batches were produced and the consumer never heard about it.
